entries.name: Inscribed Door
entries.description: A massive stone doorway is covered in glowing or carved unknown inscriptions arranged in concentric bands.
entries.hint: Certain recurring runes correspond to cardinal directions or elemental motifs.
entries.possible_reward: Access to a secluded vault or ancient cache.
entries.possible_consequence: Triggering a blinding flash or locking down the corridor.

entries.name: Recessed Pedestal
entries.description: A central stone pedestal features a precisely shaped geometric recess (triangular or octagonal).
entries.hint: The weight or material of the inserted offering matters as much as the shape.
entries.possible_reward: A hidden compartment opens beneath the altar.
entries.possible_consequence: Poison gas hisses from vents around the pedestal base.

entries.name: Movable Statues
entries.description: Several heavy guardian statues on grooved floor tracks can be rotated or slid into alignments.
entries.hint: The gazes of the statues may all need to focus on a central glyph or away from the door.
entries.possible_reward: Unlocks the main sealed passage forward.
entries.possible_consequence: The statues lock in place and darts fire from their eyes.

entries.name: Rotating Ring Portal
entries.description: A circular stone doorway contains several rotating rings covered in unfamiliar astronomical symbols.
entries.hint: Aligning symbols representing planetary phases or seasons creates a continuous circuit.
entries.possible_reward: The door slides silently into the masonry.
entries.possible_consequence: The rings bind tightly, triggering a concussive shockwave.

entries.name: Patterned Floor Tiles
entries.description: The chamber floor is paved with alternating patterned tiles depicting beasts, weapons, and celestial bodies.
entries.hint: Only tiles bearing a specific motif bear weight without sinking.
entries.possible_reward: Safe traverse to an elevated alcove with treasure.
entries.possible_consequence: Stepping on the wrong tile releases a trapdoor or floor spike.

entries.name: Balance Scales of Judgement
entries.description: A set of oversized iron scales stands beside a sealed doorway, with one pan visibly weighted down by blackened stones.
entries.hint: Balancing the scales requires an equal sacrifice of weight or personal value.
entries.possible_reward: The counterweight mechanism lifts the iron portcullis.
entries.possible_consequence: The scales tip violently, dumping burning pitch onto the floor.

entries.name: Mechanism Levers
entries.description: Several rusted iron levers protrude from a bronze wall console, each set at differing angles.
entries.hint: The sound of internal gears clicks at differing pitches when levers are pulled in order.
entries.possible_reward: Drains a flooded section or disables regional traps.
entries.possible_consequence: Jams the mechanism and activates a loud siren or alarm bell.

entries.name: Concealed Mural Mechanism
entries.description: A faded fresco depicting a historic siege conceals subtle pressure points aligned with soldiers' shields.
entries.hint: Depressing the shields in chronological order of the battle depiction releases the latch.
entries.possible_reward: A hidden door swings open into a secret annex.
entries.possible_consequence: The wall panel vibrates and unleashes a cloud of blinding dust.
